name: drift-tube-diffusion
description: Closed form: L / (mu E) with mu declared, not derived. The three per cent tolerance is the packet's own spread, not a modelling allowance - a metre-wide Gaussian arriving over a boundary has a mean transit slightly past its centroid. A 38 mm drift tube at 1 mbar, described the way the second transport mode describes things: as a density evolving in time rather than as trajectories. Above about 1e-2 mbar an ion has forgotten where it came from long before it arrives, and what survives is a distribution - so REG-1 makes statistical diffusion a peer of trajectory integration rather than a fallback from it, and RND-8 forbids drawing lines through the result. The mobility is declared rather than derived from the cross section, which is what TRN-1 asks for and is also what keeps the expected number arithmetic: 0.09 m^2/(V s) in 2 kV/m is 180 m/s, so 38 mm takes 211 us. A density has no flight time and says so; what it has is a transit-time distribution, and this is its mean.
